=# II. Promote OAC and tell us about it=

The best idea is to point your friends and other community members to the {{Link|OAC:Project|OAC BIKI page}}.<br>
Good supplements are the {{Link|link= http://oac.armaholic.eu|text= OAC page}} and the {{Link|link= http://forums.bistudio.com/showthread.php?t=68736|text= OAC thread}} in the BI forum.

Please always add these three sources to threads and news posts.

'''A request to news writers''':<br>
Please add news about OAC at your page to his section for us to know so that<br>
we can help with questions and gather feedback from the comments.

'''Thank you!'''
